era.title: Interstellar Expansion
era.subtitle: Humanity becomes a multi-star civilization beyond the Solar System
era.description: This era marks humanity's expansion beyond the Solar System into nearby star systems. Interstellar travel, self-sustaining exoplanet colonies, Dyson swarms, advanced energy systems, longevity breakthroughs, and independent branches of civilization emerge, transforming humanity into a multi-star civilization.
